queries.query: I want to make a devlog. Let's start by building the game: a 3D remake of Breakout that runs in the browser, no game engine.
quero fazer um devlog: primeiro você constrói o jogo, um Tetris em 3D no navegador, e depois a gente faz o vídeo mostrando como foi feito
Build a physics simulation of a domino city collapsing, in the browser, then make a video showing how you built it.
Code a Mandelbrot set explorer with a really deep zoom, and keep a record of how you build it, because I want a making-of video about it for YouTube afterwards.
Make a devlog video about how I built my roguelike. The game is in ./game and its git history has the whole story.
cria um simulador de fluidos no navegador e depois um vídeo contando como você fez, estilo devlog, narrado em português
I want a YouTube devlog where an AI builds a voxel destruction sandbox from scratch and the video tells the story of the build. Start with the sandbox; show it to me before you write any script.
The lander is approved. Before the script, film the landing again from a low angle in the final look.
Build a gravity simulator with orbits and collisions. Keep notes and recordings as you go: I'll make a video about how it was made.
faz um devlog do Flappy Bird em 3D: constrói o jogo primeiro e me mostra pra aprovar antes do roteiro
Make a 60-second animated explainer about how a ray tracer works.
Build me a Snake game that runs in the browser.
Give me three ideas for a devlog video. I don't know what to build yet, just ideas for now.
Make a 30-second promo video for my budgeting app.
Animate quicksort's code being typed line by line, as a 20-second clip for Shorts.
Make a lyric video for song.mp3 with an 8-bit video game look.
Write a development log for the last sprint of my app in docs/CHANGES.md.
faz um vídeo de 15 segundos de um jogo de plataforma em pixel art, só a animação, sem jogo de verdade
Make a tutorial video teaching how to set up a React project step by step, for beginners.
Make a demo video of my finished web app's main features, with a voiceover, for the landing page.
